_meta.objective: Find a working method to download Douyin videos from a datacenter IP without login
_meta.constraint_summary: Cloud Linux VM, no login/cookies, no paid APIs, polite bounded retries
_meta.verifying_ip_class: datacenter (HK region per prior research worklog)

verified_working_methods.name: dtk_console_demo_at_api_douyin_wtf
verified_working_methods.description: Evil0ctal's self-hosted Douyin_TikTok_Download_API v5 public demo instance. The operator publishes demo credentials via the unauthenticated /api/v1/auth/demo endpoint. Login with the demo creds returns a session cookie carrying the douyin:read scope. The session can then call /api/v1/douyin/video (or the unified /api/v1/parse) to fetch full video metadata including direct CDN URLs. The instance runs CloakBrowser (Chromium 146) with 572 active minted Douyin identities at time of verification — so all the signature/cookie-minting heavy lifting happens on the demo operator's infrastructure, not ours. From the datacenter IP perspective this is anonymous (no account creation, no Douyin login, no cookies we own).
verified_working_methods.curl_example:
# 1. Fetch published demo credentials (anonymous)
DEMOCREDS=$(curl -s https://api.douyin.wtf/api/v1/auth/demo)
USER=$(echo $DEMOCREDS | jq -r .data.username)
PASS=$(echo $DEMOCREDS | jq -r .data.password)
# 2. Login -> cookie jar
curl -s -c /tmp/dtk_cookies.txt \
  -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d "{\"username\":\"$USER\",\"password\":\"$PASS\"}" \
  https://api.douyin.wtf/api/v1/auth/login
# 3. Fetch video metadata (synchronous wait)
AWEME_ID=7324982373882400063
curl -s -b /tmp/dtk_cookies.txt \
  "https://api.douyin.wtf/api/v1/douyin/video?aweme_id=$AWEME_ID&wait=25" \
  -o video.json
# 4. Extract CDN URL and download
VID_URL=$(jq -r '.data.media.video.urls[0]' video.json)
curl -s -H 'Referer: https://www.douyin.com/' \
  -H 'User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 ...' \
  -o "${AWEME_ID}.mp4" "$VID_URL"

caveats: Demo instance is shared, rate-limited, and may be revoked or shut down by the operator at any time — not safe to depend on for production
Demo creds rotate; the /api/v1/auth/demo endpoint always returns the current valid demo password, so always fetch fresh rather than hardcoding
Cookie TTL is 7 days (expires_in: 604800) but the operator can revoke early; on 401, re-login
For short v.douyin.com share links, use POST /api/v1/parse with body {"url":"https://v.douyin.com/xxx"} — the worker expands the redirect internally
Verify the aweme_id is still alive before showing it to users: deleted videos return 404 NOT_FOUND from the upstream
Instance advertises wait_max=30 seconds; for hot aweme_ids the synchronous path returns in ~1s
verified_working_methods.production_recommendation: Use api.douyin.wtf demo for evaluation/CI only. For production self-host Evil0ctal/Douyin_TikTok_Download_API v5 (Docker + CloakBrowser) — see honest_impossible_without_docker below.

secondary_endpoints_verified.name: dtk_unified_parse_post
secondary_endpoints_verified.notes: Same JSON output as the platform-specific /douyin/video endpoint. Better for production because users paste arbitrary share text (long URL, short v.douyin.com link, or clipboard text containing a link) and the worker expands and dispatches internally.

secondary_endpoints_verified.name: dtk_parse_url_pre_flight
secondary_endpoints_verified.notes: Lightweight pre-flight: no upstream Douyin call. Identifies platform (douyin/tiktok), resource kind (video/user/collection), aweme_id, and whether the URL needs expansion. Use this to validate input before committing to a heavier fetch_one_video call.

methods_attempted_and_dead.name: direct_douyin_web_aweme_detail

methods_attempted_and_dead.notes: Direct Douyin web API requires Argus anti-bot signature (a_bogus, X-Bogus, X-Gnarly). Cannot be called from a datacenter IP without a CloakBrowser-style guest identity minter.

methods_not_explored_fully.name: socks5_residential_proxy_farm
methods_not_explored_fully.endpoint_pattern: Fetch SOCKS5 list from TheSpeedX/PROXY-List, route a curl with full browser headers through it, parse the resulting HTML for the play_addr URL list
methods_not_explored_fully.reason_skipped: Working dtk demo found before this brittle fallback was needed. Would only be worth building if api.douyin.wtf demo is revoked — and even then, residential proxies are unstable, slow, and the Douyin anti-bot signatures (a_bogus, X-Bogus, X-Gnarly, X-Dynosaur) require JS-evaluation, so a bare SOCKS5 fetch alone is not sufficient without also running the CloakBrowser signature minter. In other words, SOCKS5 alone is not a viable path.

methods_not_explored_fully.name: self_hosted_cobalt_v10
methods_not_explored_fully.reason_skipped: No public community relays known to be alive for Douyin. Self-hosting Cobalt requires Docker (out of no-Docker scope) and a working Douyin parser plugin; not investigated further because dtk demo covers the use case.

honest_impossible_without_docker_assessm.summary: The fundamental constraint is unchanged from the prior research worklog: from a datacenter IP, Douyin's anti-bot (Argus, a_bogus, X-Bogus, X-Gnarly, X-Dynosaur) cannot be satisfied by any lightweight CLI path. The only working approaches all rely on a CloakBrowser-style guest-identity minter — i.e. a headless Chromium with browser-grade TLS, JS evaluation, and a constantly-rotated cookie jar. That minter itself requires Docker (or equivalent container/orchestration) to run.
what_is_truly_impossible: Calling https://www.douyin.com/aweme/v1/web/aweme/detail/ directly from a datacenter IP — Argus blocks it
yt-dlp Douyin with self-minted cookies from a datacenter IP — Douyin no longer hands out anonymous cookies to datacenter IPs (verified again today)
jiji262/douyin-downloader CLI — author acknowledges verification wall blocks CLI downloads

Bare SOCKS5 residential-proxy fetch of the Douyin page HTML — even if the page loads, the play_addr URLs are only embedded in a JS bundle that requires signature parameters generated by Douyin's JS crypto (a_bogus etc.) — so the page is useless without the signature minter
what_is_actually_possible_without_docker: Use api.douyin.wtf demo (someone else runs the Docker stack for us) — VERIFIED WORKING 2026-10-03
Use any other public dtk instance where an operator publishes demo creds — same pattern, findable via OpenAPI spec fetch
Self-host Evil0ctal/Douyin_TikTok_Download_API v5 — this is the production answer but DOES require Docker + CloakBrowser + headless Chromium. Without Docker, there is no working self-host path.
honest_impossible_without_docker_assessm.recommended_production_path: Two-tier: (1) Tier-A default uses api.douyin.wtf demo for evaluation/CI/single-shot downloads. (2) Tier-B production uses a self-hosted Evil0ctal v5 instance (Docker required) pointed at by AVD_DOUYIN_DTK_URL env var (already wired in src/avd/extractors/douyin.py slot 1). When neither is available, return the honest 'datacenter_ip_walled' error already coded in slot 3. Do NOT spend cycles on SOCKS5 farms or yt-dlp cookie-minting — they don't actually work for Douyin's current signature stack.
honest_impossible_without_docker_assessm.code_integration_status: src/avd/extractors/douyin.py already has a _try_dtk_sidecar slot wired to AVD_DOUYIN_DTK_URL. To use the public demo as a zero-config default, set the demo's base URL (https://api.douyin.wtf) as the fallback when AVD_DOUYIN_DTK_URL is unset, and add a demo-creds-aware login step before the fetch_one_video call. CDN allowlist should be extended to include zjcdn.com (the Zhejiang Douyin CDN observed serving the verified video).
